title: Sentinel — Reduction Ratio SLO
description: P3-06 AC3: the platform-wide and per-tenant signal-to-case reduction ratio, the business-critical SLO (target >= 10:1, alert floor 8:1 — see infra/docker/grafana-provisioning/alerting/reduction-ratio.yml) that determines whether this product's unit economics hold. correlate_reduction_ratio is set once per tenant per day (cmd/correlate/main.go's own runReductionRatioSweep), after that tenant's own previous completed day.

panels.title: Platform-wide reduction ratio (worst tenant)
panels.description: min(correlate_reduction_ratio) across every tenant — the same aggregation the alert rule itself evaluates, so this number is always exactly what would currently be firing or not.

panels.title: Reduction ratio by tenant
panels.description: correlate_reduction_ratio by tenant_id — a flat line at 10 below the dashed 8:1 line means that tenant's own signal volume collapses to roughly a tenth as many escalated cases every day, the target this ticket's own SLO measures against.
